title: Centre Nautique Pierre Plouffe

services.name: Surf - wakeboard
services.desc: Surfez le lac Tremblant comme jamais auparavant! Le wakesurf est l’une des tendances les plus populaires du moment, et nous sommes fiers d’offrir cette expérience unique dans un décor aussi spectaculaire. Glisser au ras de l’eau, profiter de la vague et ressentir la liberté du surf sans corde… c’est toute la magie du wakesurf. Accessible autant aux débutants curieux qu’aux amateurs de sensations fortes, c’est une activité qui combine plaisir, style et adrénaline. Et le mieux? L’expérience se vit aussi entre amis ou en famille - jusqu’à 8 personnes peuvent prendre part à la sortie, avec des forfaits spécialement conçus pour les groupes. C’est l’activité parfaite pour partager un moment

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: In Quebec and the rest of Canada, all operators of a motorized pleasure craft must have proof of competency in their possession. Proof of competency is mandatory, regardless of the age, length of the boat or the strength and type of engine used. To obtain a pleasure craft licenseHere are 3 websites where you can get a boat license:cartebateau.com - examenbateau.com - coursnautique.com The Watersport Center is actively committed to preserving the water quality of Tremblant Lake and promoting respect among all lake users. We believe it is essential to encourage responsible boating practices in order to ensure harmonious coexistence between boaters, swimmers, athletes, and nature enthusiasts.

services.name: Motorboat rentals
services.desc: Treat yourself to an exceptional moment on the waters of Lake Tremblant aboard our motorized boats. Whether you’re looking for a peaceful escape, a fun outing with friends, or a fishing trip, enjoy optimal comfort in a truly breathtaking natural setting. Our leisure boats (4 persons) and Princecraft pontoon boats (6 to 12 people) are perfectly suited to help you experience the lake in total freedom and serenity-whether with friends or family. (Coolers are welcome.)
